text:
[issue by Konhaiii]
**Describe the bug**
When an Accumulator multiblock (only when 2 or more blocks are connected, the block itself dont throw a crash) is mounted on a moving contraption, either the game crash immediately or it does when the contraption stops.

It may be due to recent changes on how contraptions are handled in Create.

**To Reproduce**
1-Place a Mechanical Bearing
2-Glue an Accumulator multiblock on it
3-Apply rotational force
4-If the game has not crashed already, break the mechanical bearing
5-Tada! game crashed

**Additional context**
- Mod version: 1.2.4e
- Forge version: 47.3.10
- Create version: 0.5.1.h
- Minecraft version: 1.20.1

[crash-2024-09-22_17.59.33-server.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17090372/crash-2024-09-22_17.59.33-server.txt)

It's an issue on Creates side, either downgrade to Create 0.5.1.g or wait for Create 0.5.1.i
